title: Objects of $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ descend to a finite extension
statement:
Let $X$ be a standing scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and fix the prime $\ell$ and algebraic closure $\Qlb=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the bounded constructible categories $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ of [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude], with the pulled-back condensed coefficient rings, not constant discrete rational coefficient sheaves. All finite fields below are intermediate fields of $\Qlb/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Write $C_F=T_{E,F}C$ and $C_{\Qlb}=T_{E,\Qlb}C$ for the derived extensions of scalars [def-sfb-derived-extend-subfield, def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar]. Here these functors act on unbounded derived categories of module objects in $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$; in particular $T_{E,\Qlb}$ is the coefficient-change functor for the condensed inclusion $\underline E\to\underline{\Qlb}$, as specified by [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar].

For every $K\in\Dbc(X,\Qlb)$ there are a finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $K_E\in\Dbc(X,E)$ with $(K_E)_{\Qlb}\cong K$. If $K_E$ is such a model over $E$ and $E\subseteq F\subseteq\Qlb$ is finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, then $(K_E)_F\in\Dbc(X,F)$ and $((K_E)_F)_{\Qlb}\cong K$, so $(K_E)_F$ is a model over $F$.

proof.text: The standing finite-type scheme over Spec k is locally Noetherian. Quasi-compactness over Spec k gives compactness, hence X is Noetherian. Every stratum immersion is an embedding, so its domain has a Noetherian underlying space as well. These are exactly the hypotheses required by coefficient local triviality and constructible-cocone object descent.

proof.text: Compare the constant-model and stratified locally finitely presented constructibility predicates on the same finite stratification. A finite constant model is locally finitely presented by HasFiniteConstantLocalModel.isLocallyFinitelyPresented. Conversely, finite_lf and algcl_lf (the coefficient and raw-pullback transports of the finite-field and algebraic-closure local-triviality theorems in CondensedConstructibleSerre) give finite-free covers on each Noetherian stratum. A finite free module of rank n is the inverse image of the same finite free condensed module on the point: upperStarFromPoint is a left adjoint, its module functor preserves finite colimits and finite biproducts, and it sends the regular module to the regular module. The condensed finite free module has the finite presentation coker(0 : Lambda^n -> Lambda^n). Transport local finite presentation and freeness along the invertible condensedPullbackHom using lfp_comap, lfp_of_comap, lfp_of_iso, free_comap and free_of_iso from CondensedConstructibleSerre. This proves equality of the module predicates and then, degree by degree with the identical boundedness condition, equality constantModelBoundedConstructible = boundedConstructible for both field coefficient types. No nonempty stratum or positive rank is required.

proof.text: View K in the source bounded constructible category using the equality just proved. Apply the existing same-unit constructibleCocone_essSurjObj to obtain a finite E, a source bounded constructible model L, and an isomorphism in the full subcategory. Use the finite-field predicate equality to view the very same underlying L as a constant-model bounded constructible object. Map its isomorphism through the full-subcategory inclusion to the ambient derived category. The cocone functor is definitionally the specified derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl. Thus the result has exactly the requested model and ambient isomorphism; no new descent theorem is assumed.

proof.text: For a given model K_E and inclusion E <= F, convert its property to source bounded constructibility, apply boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsSubfield_obj, and convert the result back by the finite-field predicate equality. Compose the component of derivedExtendScalarsCompIso at K_E with its given model isomorphism. This proves both preservation of constructibility and persistence of the model, including E = F.

lean.statement: theorem coefficient_finite_descent_objects (k : Type u) [Field k] (p ℓ : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fact ℓ.Prime] (_hp : 0 < p) (_hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ) (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] : (∀ K : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X, ∃ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (K_E : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X), Nonempty ((derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl X ℓ E).obj K_E.obj ≅ K.obj)) ∧ (∀ (K : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X) (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (K_E : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X), Nonempty ((derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl X ℓ E).obj K_E.obj ≅ K.obj) → ∀ (F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (h : E ≤ F), constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj F) X ((derivedExtendScalarsSubfield X ℓ h).obj K_E.obj) ∧ Nonempty ((derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl X ℓ F).obj ((derivedExtendScalarsSubfield X ℓ h).obj K_E.obj) ≅ K.obj))
